headline: Congress in summer recess mode: Senate and House both running on minimal sessions heading into the long weekend.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened in pro forma session on Thursday, August 20, with no business conducted. The chamber adjourned quickly and will reconvene in pro forma session on Monday with no legislative activity scheduled.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly on Thursday, August 20 for a pro forma session lasting just three minutes. Twenty new bills were introduced and eight committee reports were filed, including measures on the National Law Enforcement Museum, antisemitism discrimination enforcement in schools, and Indian land disputes, but no votes or floor debate occurred.
